[EXPERIMENTAL] Approve a change request.

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] Approve a change request

This command shows the change that the change request proposes and asks for confirmation,
then approves its latest revision. Use `env change-request get` to see how many approvals
are still required.


```
pulumi env change-request approve <change-request-id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # Approve a change request
  pulumi env change-request approve <change-request-id>

  # Approve with a comment
  pulumi env change-request approve <change-request-id> -m "Looks good"

  # Show the proposed change without approving it
  pulumi env change-request approve <change-request-id> --dry-run
```

## Options

```
      --dry-run          show the proposed change without approving it
  -h, --help             help for approve
  -m, --message string   a comment to add with the approval
  -y, --yes              skip the confirmation prompt
```
